scripts.services:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.docker:package:all: docker build --build-context error_tracker_sdk=../error-tracker/packages/sdk -t utils-plane:all -f Dockerfile . && docker save utils-plane:all -o utils-plane-all.tar
scripts.docker:package:api: docker build --build-context error_tracker_sdk=../error-tracker/packages/sdk -t utils-plane-api:latest -f apps/api/Dockerfile . && docker save utils-plane-api:latest -o utils-plane-api.tar
scripts.docker:package:offline: docker build --build-context error_tracker_sdk=../error-tracker/packages/sdk -t utils-plane:all -f Dockerfile . && docker save utils-plane:all postgres:16-alpine redis:7-alpine minio/minio:latest minio/mc:latest -o utils-plane-offline-all.tar
